{{Quote|You were right. Positive ID on the captain. Experiment chamber 21.|[[Legat]] to [[Dust (Abyssin)|Dust]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Experiment chamber 21''' was one of the rooms in the [[Republic watchtower]] in the [[High Security Section]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It was used by [[Project Noble Focus]], and during the [[invasion of Belsavis]] a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] located the [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] prisoner [[Sraja]] there, only to be ambushed by the [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Dust (Abyssin)|Dust]].
